name: Huang-fu Jen
bio: Huang-fu Jen is dated by Giles to the 9th century AD. His poem here is a palace epigram.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Spretæ Injuria Formæ
poems.author: Huang-fu Jen
poems.text:
See! fair girls are flocking, through corridors bright,
With music and mirth borne along on the breeze

Come, tell me if she who is favoured tonight
Has eyebrows much longer than these?
